summary: Frontend-only static prototype Session Lab Decision Cockpit tested end-to-end. Page mounts at /session-lab with no runtime errors or console errors. All 25+ data-testid'd interactive controls are present and clickable. All 8 deep-dive tabs switch and render their respective content (Overview, Direction, Structure, Entry, Time, OB, Failure, Streaks). Session card selection correctly updates the Deep Dive H2 title (Asia/London/London Lull/New York/NY PM/Outside with matching time ranges). Session Settings modal opens and closes via close button AND backdrop click. Run Impact Summary shows correct mock metrics (+19.8R / +28.7R / +8.9R). Visual Summary Strip 4 charts render. Streaks tab renders 27-dot sequence and Runs Test 'NOT RANDOM' verdict visible. Failure tab renders all 8 named failure cards. Time tab heatmap shows day labels (Mon/Tue/Wed). OB Lab donut + charts render. Help/Legend footer shows Positive/Negative/Neutral legend chips.

issues: Recharts emits ~10 console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first paint because <ResponsiveContainer> children measure before layout settles. Non-blocking, but noisy. Wrap charts in a parent with explicit minWidth=0 or use a useLayoutEffect to gate render, or set aspect=undefined per recharts hint.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' first-paint warnings by ensuring ResponsiveContainer parents have a measurable size before mount (e.g. min-h utility or aspect prop).

(Minor spec mismatch) Spec says Entry Model Lab table should have 8 rows (Baseline through TE Delay +3), but the rendered table currently has 12 rows. Confirm whether the extra rows (likely Penetration variants) are intended; if not, trim ENTRY_MODELS in mockData.js to the 8 canonical models.
All other tested behaviour matches the spec — no functional fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionLabPage composition is clean and uses lifted state for selectedKey/direction/previewMode/activeTab. No prop-drilling issues observed.
Recharts width(-1) warnings indicate ResponsiveContainer children may render before parent has a measured width (likely in the Visual Summary Strip / sparklines). Minor polish.
Modal correctly supports both close-button and backdrop-click dismissal — good UX.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes as required for automated testing.
Entry Model Lab table row count (12) doesn't match the spec's stated 8 rows — verify intent.
seed_data_creation: None — app uses hardcoded mock data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only prototype, no backend. Public URL https://session-lab-cockpit.preview.emergentagent.com/session-lab. All data-testids used in playbook match the implementation. Key testids: page-title, direction-toggle-(both|long|short), preview-toggle-(original|filtered), btn-(session-settings|reset-all|export|share|save-view), impact-(baseline|preview|delta), session-card-(asia|london|lull|ny|nypm|outside), toggle-{key}-(long|short|bos|choch), chart-(net-r-by-session|top-entry), trades-by-(direction|structure), deep-dive-tab-(overview|direction|structure|entry|time|ob|failure|streaks), dl-(longs|shorts)-model, el-(long|short)-model, time-view-(session|full), ob-(origin|detection)-chart, worst-cluster-view-trades, streak-filter-(all|wins|losses), qc-(longs|shorts|bos|choch|reset-session|apply-rule|save-view), session-settings-(modal|close|cancel|save). No backdrop testid but backdrop-click does close the modal.
